Preserve all 24 complete C026-S05 state combinations in their recorded order: cancelled/live lower alpha, cancelled upper-alpha/independent upper dark trace, oval 0/circle/o, and head/retrace/independent upper run. S06, after connexes, contains a zigzag with a right foot and a lower-right looped continuation, crossed by several diagonals.
